messages:
Nora Kim: Quick feedback on the dashboard axis labels — current Y axis shows full units (e.g., 123,456). Proposal: add an abbreviated unit toggle (k/M) with a clear legend suffix when enabled. Makes charts less cluttered.

Owen Blake: Agree on abbreviation. We should show the expanded value on hover tooltip though, so users can still see exact numbers.

Priya Shah: Accessibility: abbreviated units can confuse screen readers. When abbreviated is on, SR should read full value e.g., "1 hundred twenty-three thousand, four hundred fifty-six". We can store a aria-label on points.

Marcus Lee: Outlier handling: if we abbreviate, large outliers like 2.3M can hide distribution. Suggest an overflow marker that shows raw value on click. Example microcopy: ">= 1M (click to expand)".

Nora Kim: Smoothing interplay: if smoothing is on and units are abbreviated, we should indicate both statuses in legend as small chips: "Smoothed | Abbrev Units". Users should be able to toggle either.

Owen Blake: UX nit: put the unit toggle inside axis context menu rather than inline to avoid clutter. On narrow screens, expose a quick-access control in top-right chart header.

Priya Shah: Keyboard: unit toggle must be reachable by Tab and announce the new mode after toggle: "YAxis units: Short \u2013 showing in thousands". Also announce when overflow marker is expanded.

Marcus Lee: Dev note: compute abbreviated labels on render but keep full values in data model. Also, when overflow badge is clicked, open small panel with top 5 values and a link to raw table.

Designbot: Added figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/vis123/axis-abbrev-overflow 8frame: axis/abbrev-overflow-v1

Nora Kim: Decision: move forward with axis unit toggle in context menu + hover-expanded value + SR full readout + overflow marker with clickable details + legend chips showing smoothing/abbrev state. Action items: Owen update mocks, Priya write SR labels, Marcus implement overflow panel.
